crossRefs.note: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples…
Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty…
For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness…
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…

translations.web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
translations.bsb: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
translations.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
translations.asv: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.
